description: Exactly the frozen selected SyGuS benchmark inputs from the fixed official source commit, converted using the original input-only SyGuS1-to-2 parser/serializer. Frozen hidden files retain original identifiers and only change filenames; historical alpha-renaming is excluded. No solution files or solver answer checking functions are downloaded or used.
terms: Official benchmark source repository has no explicit redistribution license. Retain existing local reconstruction scope; no public image upload authorized.
